scope: Disposable PostgreSQL 17; full Tenancy/session fences, no HTTP/cache latency. Five sequential samples; p95 is sample maximum, not a production SLO. Statement counts exclude exact Prisma SELECT 1 pool health checks (separately recorded with all wire counts) and the explicit measurement barrier. Synthetic invitations have no outbox delivery; no proofs are issued to real users.
